1: // Minimal endless runner based on IDEA.md
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if (!canvas) return;
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800;
7:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 200;
8: 
9:   // player
10:   const player = { x: 50, y: H - 30, size: 20, vy: 0, jumpPower: -8, onGround: true };
11:   const GRAVITY = 0.4;
12: 
13:   // obstacles
14:   const obstacles = [];
15:   const OBSTACLE_INTERVAL = 1500; // ms
16:   let lastObs = 0;
17: 
18:   // score
19:   let score = 0;
20:   let startTime = performance.now();
21: 
22:   // audio setup
23:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
24:   function playTone(frequency, duration) {
25:     const oscillator = audioCtx.createOscillator();
26:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
27:     oscillator.type = 'square';
28:     oscillator.frequency.value = frequency;
29:     oscillator.connect(gain);
30:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
31:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
32:     oscillator.start();
33:     oscillator.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
34:   }
35:   function playJumpSound() { playTone(440, 0.1); }
36:   function playGameOverSound() { playTone(150, 0.3); }
37: 
38:   // input
39:   const jump = () => {
40:     if (player.onGround) {
41:       player.vy = player.jumpPower;
42:       player.onGround = false;
43:       playJumpSound();
44:     }
45:   };
46:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.code === 'Space' || e.key === ' ') jump(); });
47:   canvas.addEventListener('click', jump);
48: 
49:   function spawnObstacle() {
50:     const size = 20 + Math.random() * 20;
51:     obstacles.push({ x: W, y: H - size, w: size, h: size, speed: 3 });
52:   }
53: 
54:   function update(dt) {
55:     // player physics
56:     player.vy += GRAVITY;
57:     player.y += player.vy;
58:     if (player.y + player.size >= H) {
59:       player.y = H - player.size;
60:       player.vy = 0;
61:       player.onGround = true;
62:     }
63: 
64:     // obstacles movement
65:     obstacles.forEach(o => o.x -= o.speed);
66:     // remove passed obstacles
67:     while (obstacles.length && obstacles[0].x + obstacles[0].w < 0) obstacles.shift();
68: 
69:     // spawn new obstacles
70:     if (performance.now() - lastObs > OBSTACLE_INTERVAL) {
71:       spawnObstacle();
72:       lastObs = performance.now();
73:     }
74: 
75:     // collision detection
76:     for (const o of obstacles) {
77:       if (player.x < o.x + o.w && player.x + player.size > o.x &&
78:           player.y < o.y + o.h && player.y + player.size > o.y) {
79:         // lose condition – stop the loop
80:         cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
81:         playGameOverSound();
82:         setTimeout(() => {
83:           alert('Game Over! Score: ' + score);
84:         }, 300);
85:         return false;
86:       }
87:     }
88:     // update score
89:     score = Math.floor((performance.now() - startTime) / 100);
90:     return true;
91:   }
92: 
93:   function draw() {
94:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
95:     // background gradient
96:     const grd = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
97:     grd.addColorStop(0, '#222');
98:     grd.addColorStop(1, '#000');
99:     ctx.fillStyle = grd;
100:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
101:     // scrolling ground line
102:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#555';
103:     ctx.lineWidth = 2;
104:     ctx.beginPath();
105:     ctx.moveTo(0, H - 10);
106:     ctx.lineTo(W, H - 10);
107:     ctx.stroke();
108:     // simple parallax stars
109:     ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
110:     for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
111:       const sx = (i * 50 - bgOffset) % W;
112:       ctx.fillRect(sx, 20 + (i % 5) * 10, 2, 2);
113:     }
114:     // player with slight shadow
115:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
116:     ctx.fillRect(player.x + 2, player.y + 2, player.size, player.size);
117:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0b0';
118:     ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.size, player.size);
119:     // obstacles with gradient
120:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
121:       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(o.x, o.y, o.x, o.y + o.h);
122:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#f44');
123:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#800');
124:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
125:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
126:     });
127:     // score
128:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
129:     ctx.font = '16px monospace';
130:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
131:   }
132: 
133:   let lastTime = 0;
134:   let animId;
135:   function loop(timestamp) {
136:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
137:     lastTime = timestamp;
138:     if (update(dt)) {
139:       draw();
140:       animId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
141:     }
142:   }
143:   animId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
144: })();
